title: Four Minutes From Home
youtube_title: My GPS Said 4 Minutes From Home. For 3 Hours. #shorts #scarystories
caption: Driving home for Thanksgiving, my exit kept coming back. Then my mom called from the window. 😨 Follow for a new scary story every day.
style: dark cinematic digital painting, eerie moonlight, deep shadows, muted palette, horror movie still

scenes.text: My GPS has said four minutes to home for the last three hours.
scenes.image_prompt: glowing car dashboard GPS screen at night on a dark highway, blurred road through the windshield

scenes.text: I'm driving back for Thanksgiving, on the same highway I've taken every year since college.
scenes.image_prompt: empty two-lane highway at night lined with bare autumn trees, headlights cutting through light fog

scenes.text: Exit forty one, my exit, keeps passing on the right. Same dented sign. Same flickering streetlight.
scenes.image_prompt: dented green highway exit sign at night under a single flickering streetlight, empty road

scenes.text: So I take it. The ramp curves through the dark, and drops me right back onto the highway, at mile marker thirty eight.
scenes.image_prompt: curving highway off-ramp at night disappearing into darkness, small roadside mile marker post in headlights

scenes.text: Finally my phone rings. It's my mom. She asks why I've been sitting in the driveway with the engine running.
scenes.image_prompt: smartphone lighting up on a car passenger seat at night, incoming call glow, dark car interior

scenes.text: I tell her I'm not home yet. I'm still on the highway. There's a long silence.
scenes.image_prompt: view through a car windshield of an endless dark highway at night, no other cars, faint fog

scenes.text: Then she whispers, honey, I can see you from the kitchen window. You're right there.
scenes.image_prompt: warm lit kitchen window of a suburban house at night seen from outside, lace curtain pulled aside, silhouette

scenes.text: I look in the rearview mirror. My house is behind me, porch light on. And in the driveway sits my car, with someone in the driver's seat, waving.
scenes.image_prompt: car rearview mirror at night reflecting a suburban house with porch light on and a parked car in the driveway, eerie
